name: LCG071S-PRO frameset

editorial.verdict: A well-documented, practical 50C budget frame for a custom build, but not a full aero-shell or road-geometry answer.
caveats: DIY complete costs far more than Twitter EDS
Conventional utility-focused gravel layout with 430 mm chainstays

included: Frame and LightCarbon-specific carbon gravel fork
